lines.en: Did you hear about our friend's restaurant? It closed last week after eleven years. She must have felt terrible.
lines.pt: Você soube do restaurante da nossa amiga? Fechou semana passada depois de onze anos. Ela deve ter se sentido péssima.

lines.en: I heard, yes. She might have lost her savings too, and she probably worked there every single day without a break.
lines.pt: Soube, sim. Ela pode ter perdido as economias também, e provavelmente trabalhava lá todo dia sem folga.

lines.en: Probably. She must have been sleeping badly for months, with all that pressure. I should have called her last month, but I kept putting it off.
lines.pt: Provavelmente. Ela deve ter dormido mal por meses, com toda essa pressão. Eu devia ter ligado para ela no mês passado, mas fui adiando.

lines.en: Don't be so hard on yourself. We all assumed things were fine, because she always looked cheerful when we ate there.
lines.pt: Não seja tão dura consigo mesmo. Todos nós achamos que estava tudo bem, porque ela sempre parecia alegre quando comíamos lá.

lines.en: True. Still, she should have told us earlier. We could have helped, or at least organized a fundraiser.
lines.pt: Verdade. Mesmo assim, ela devia ter nos contado antes. Poderíamos ter ajudado, ou pelo menos organizado uma vaquinha.

lines.en: Maybe she was too embarrassed. Some people hate asking for help, and she's always been the one giving it, remember?
lines.pt: Talvez ela tenha ficado com vergonha. Algumas pessoas odeiam pedir ajuda, e ela sempre foi quem ajudava, lembra?

lines.en: Right. I wrote a whole speech last night, but we needn't have prepared one. A simple hug might say more.
lines.pt: Verdade. Escrevi um discurso inteiro ontem à noite, mas nem precisávamos ter preparado um. Um abraço simples talvez diga mais.

lines.en: I agree. Let's visit her on Sunday with a card, some flowers, and her favorite chocolate. I'll ask the others to join.
lines.pt: Concordo. Vamos visitá-la no domingo com um cartão, flores e o chocolate favorito dela. Vou pedir aos outros que venham.

lines.en: Great. Actually, I've been reading The House on Mango Street, and it made me think about how hard it is to leave a place you love.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Aliás, tenho lido A Casa na Rua Mango, e isso me fez pensar em como é difícil deixar um lugar que você ama.

lines.en: I love that book. Esperanza's neighborhood feels so real. Maybe we could ask her to tell us how the restaurant started.
lines.pt: Adoro esse livro. O bairro da Esperanza parece tão real. Talvez possamos pedir que ela nos conte como o restaurante começou.

lines.en: That's a lovely idea. People need to feel their work mattered, and hers certainly did. I'll bring my camera to record it.
lines.pt: Que ideia linda. As pessoas precisam sentir que seu trabalho importou, e o dela com certeza importou. Vou levar minha câmera para registrar.

facts.label: Modais perfeitos
facts.sub: Dedução: She must have felt terrible. Possibilidade: might have. Arrependimento: should have. Sem necessidade: needn’t have.

facts.label: Deve ter
facts.sub: Use must have + particípio para deduzir algo do passado com muita certeza: She must have felt terrible. Em português: “deve ter sentido”. Na fala vira must’ve.

facts.label: Pode ter
facts.sub: Para possibilidade: She might have lost her savings. Menos certeza que must have. Compare: must have = quase certo; might have = talvez.

solo: Pergunte em que situação o aluno já passou por isso.

Peça um exemplo real da vida de cada aluno.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ela deve ter ficado…” para deduzir sentimentos.
compare.us: Em inglês, must have + particípio faz o mesmo: She must have felt terrible.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: She must have felt terrible.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Must have + participle is a strong deduction about the past.
Should have means something was certain.
items.why: It means a regret or criticism.

items.s: Might have + participle expresses a possibility.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Must have + participle is a strong deduction about the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Should have means something was certain. → Falso (It means a regret or criticism.)
Might have + participle expresses a possibility. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: When a restaurant closes · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy evening in Chicago. Ida and Max meet near the river. A friend of theirs has just closed her restaurant. Nobody knew she was in trouble. Ida and Max try to imagine how she feels. They decide to do something kind.

“Did you hear about our friend’s restaurant? It closed last week after eleven years. She must have felt terrible.” says Ida. “She must have been devastated. She might have lost her savings too, and she must have worked there every day.” says Max. “So hard, for so long. And she should have told us earlier. We could have helped her somehow.” says Ida.

paragraphs: “Good idea. I’ll bring soup. She might have been skipping meals, and she must have been sleeping badly.” says Max. “Poor thing. She must have felt that everything was falling apart.
